en: Tono and Mama are walking to the warung to buy eggs.
They come to a busy road. Motorbikes go brrm, brrm! Tono holds Mama's hand tight.
They stop at the zebra crossing. Look right. Look left. Look right again. Listen!
A motorbike is coming. Wait, wait... Whoosh! It goes past.
Now the road is clear. They look again, then walk straight across. No running!
At the warung Tono says, 'We stopped, we looked, we listened, and we walked!'
id: Tono dan Mama berjalan ke warung untuk membeli telur.
Mereka sampai di jalan yang ramai. Motor berbunyi brem, brem! Tono menggenggam tangan Mama erat-erat.
Mereka berhenti di zebra cross. Lihat kanan. Lihat kiri. Lihat kanan lagi. Dengarkan!
Ada motor datang. Tunggu, tunggu... Wus! Motornya lewat.
Sekarang jalannya kosong. Mereka melihat sekali lagi, lalu berjalan lurus menyeberang. Tidak berlari!
Di warung Tono berkata, 'Kita berhenti, melihat, mendengar, lalu berjalan!'

readAloudNotes.en: Walk your fingers along the page like two people walking.
readAloudNotes.id: Jalankan jari di halaman seperti dua orang berjalan.

readAloudNotes.en: Make a motorbike sound and squeeze your child's hand gently.
readAloudNotes.id: Tirukan suara motor dan genggam tangan anak dengan lembut.

readAloudNotes.en: Turn your head slowly right, then left, then right again, and cup a hand to your ear.
readAloudNotes.id: Tolehkan kepala pelan ke kanan, ke kiri, lalu ke kanan lagi, dan dekatkan tangan ke telinga.

readAloudNotes.en: Hold up a hand for 'wait', then sweep it past for 'whoosh'.
readAloudNotes.id: Angkat tangan untuk 'tunggu', lalu ayunkan untuk 'wus'.

readAloudNotes.en: Look right, left and right once more before you 'walk' your fingers across.
readAloudNotes.id: Lihat kanan, kiri, dan kanan sekali lagi sebelum jari 'berjalan' menyeberang.

readAloudNotes.en: Say the four words together, counting them on your fingers.
readAloudNotes.id: Ucapkan empat kata itu bersama sambil menghitung dengan jari.

sequenceCards.en: Card 1: a boy and his mother walking on a pavement
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 1: anak laki-laki dan ibunya berjalan di trotoar

sequenceCards.en: Card 2: the two of them stopped at a zebra crossing, looking
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 2: keduanya berhenti di zebra cross sambil melihat

sequenceCards.en: Card 3: a motorbike passing while they wait
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 3: motor lewat saat mereka menunggu

sequenceCards.en: Card 4: the two of them walking across the empty road
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 4: keduanya berjalan menyeberangi jalan yang kosong

sequenceCards.en: Card 5: the boy at a small shop holding eggs
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 5: anak itu di warung memegang telur

objectives.en: Sequences the steps for crossing a road with an adult.
objectives.id: Mengurutkan langkah menyeberang jalan bersama orang dewasa.

objectives.en: Explains why we wait until the road is clear.
objectives.id: Menjelaskan mengapa kita menunggu sampai jalan kosong.

meaning.en: white stripes on the road where people cross
meaning.id: garis putih di jalan tempat orang menyeberang

prompt.en: What did Tono and Mama do first at the road?
prompt.id: Apa yang pertama dilakukan Tono dan Mama di jalan?

prompt.en: In the story, what does 'the road is clear' mean?

en: the road is full of cars

prompt.en: Why did Tono hold Mama's hand tight?
prompt.id: Mengapa Tono menggenggam tangan Mama erat-erat?

en: to stay safe near the busy road
id: supaya aman di dekat jalan ramai

connection.en: Young children cross roads only with an adult: stop, look both ways, listen, then walk.
connection.id: Anak kecil menyeberang hanya bersama orang dewasa: berhenti, lihat ke dua arah, dengarkan, lalu berjalan.

discussionPrompts.en: What sounds tell us a car or motorbike is coming?
discussionPrompts.id: Suara apa yang memberi tahu kita ada mobil atau motor datang?

discussionPrompts.en: Who do you hold hands with near the road?
discussionPrompts.id: Dengan siapa kamu bergandengan tangan di dekat jalan?

offlineActivity.en: Make a pretend road on the floor with two lines of tape or rope and roll a toy car along it. Practise 'stop, look, listen, walk' while holding hands. Later, practise the same words on a real walk, always holding hands.
offlineActivity.id: Buat jalan pura-pura di lantai dengan dua garis selotip atau tali, lalu gelindingkan mobil mainan. Latih 'berhenti, lihat, dengar, jalan' sambil bergandengan tangan. Nanti, latih kata-kata yang sama saat berjalan sungguhan, selalu sambil bergandengan tangan.

factChecks.claim: Young children should cross roads only with an adult.

safetyNotes.en: Children of this age must never cross a road alone. Practise on a quiet path first, and always hold hands near traffic.
safetyNotes.id: Anak seusia ini tidak boleh menyeberang jalan sendirian. Berlatihlah dulu di jalan yang sepi, dan selalu bergandengan tangan di dekat kendaraan.
